messages:
incident-bot: :warning: ALERT: streaming-proxy.us-east-1 5xx rate anomaly detected. 5m error rate=11.8% (norm 0.5%). Triggered at 2026-03-14T11:11:30Z. Dash: https://metrics.redwood/alerts/streaming-1804567890

oncall-zoe: I'm taking this. Any recent infra/config pushes in the past 30m?

harper-eng: There's a partial config rollout (cfg-2026-03-14-1100) that enabled opportunistic chunking and reduced connection keepalive on a subset of proxies ~16m ago. Not a code change.

sam-deploy: Rollout details: chunking.enabled=true on canary (25% hosts), proxy.keepalive=20s (was 45s). Rollout id cfg-2026-03-14-1100.

marta-ops: Observing repeated "upstream write error" and "RST_STREAM" in proxy logs around 11:08-11:12. Sample: ```[2026-03-14T11:09:12Z] id=stream-7G auth=acct-303 upstream=lb-pool-5 code=503 msg="upstream write error: broken pipe" client_cancel=true headers={chunked=true}```

oncall-zoe: That log pattern + chunking flip smells like proxy tries to emit partial chunks after client CANCEL and that triggers upstream failures. Proposed immediate steps: 1) pause cfg-2026-03-14-1100, 2) set feature flag chunking=false for us-east-1, 3) drain problematic backends, 4) raise keepalive to 90s temporarily. Which is lowest-risk first?

harper-eng: Pause rollout now please. I'll also gather traces for client CANCEL -> write sequence.

sam-deploy: Pausing rollout: `rollout pause cfg-2026-03-14-1100` -> done.

[system]: infra-bot: rollout cfg-2026-03-14-1100 paused by sam-deploy.

marta-ops: Starting drains on lb-pool-5 and lb-pool-9: `infractl drain --target lb-pool-5 --grace 15s` `infractl drain --target lb-pool-9 --grace 15s`.

[system]: infra-bot: drain jobs enqueued for lb-pool-5, lb-pool-9.

oncall-zoe: Applying feature flag: `feature-flag set streaming.opportunistic_chunking false --region us-east-1` to force deterministic non-chunked responses.

[system]: feature-bot: streaming.opportunistic_chunking set to false in us-east-1 by oncall-zoe.

marta-ops: Increasing keepalive: `infractl config set proxy.keepalive 90s --region us-east-1` -> in progress.

harper-eng: Quick metrics: after pausing rollout and starting drains, 5xx dropped from 11.8% -> 3.6% in 4m. After flag and keepalive bump it's down to ~1.5% and trending down.

nina-pm: Customer impact: which customers hit? Any SLA breaches?

leo-csm: Affected customers: acct-303 (high-volume transcription), acct-411 (webchat). Roughly 2.8k streaming sessions impacted; estimated 3.2% of us-east-1 streaming requests saw truncation/5xx. No data-corruption reported.

nina-pm: I'll draft a short advisory: "We experienced a brief increase in streaming failures in us-east-1 starting ~11:07. We've applied mitigations (paused chunking rollouts, drained flapping backends, disabled opportunistic chunking, increased keepalive). Impact limited to a subset of streaming customers; we are following up with a postmortem." Approve?

leo-csm: Send to acct-303 and acct-411 now. Include workaround: client-side retry/backoff or switching to polling for critical low-latency flows.

harper-eng: Root-cause hypothesis: when opportunistic chunking is enabled, the proxy attempts to flush partial chunks after client CANCEL, which leads to writes against upstream sockets that have been closed, producing broken-pipe errors and returning 502/503 to the client. The cascade increases backend load and causes autoscaler/health-check churn.

marta-ops: Noted autoscaler behavior: health checks for lb-pool-5 flapped at 11:08:05, 11:08:22, 11:08:37 -> flapping triggered removal of some endpoints; autoscaler didn't re-add fast enough due to conservative thresholds. Filing INFRA-3350 to review.

harper-eng: Engineering mitigation plan: short-term keep chunking disabled and tune keepalive/health-checks. Medium-term change: update proxy I/O path to cancel upstream writes immediately on client CANCEL (avoid write-after-cancel). Will open RFC and attach repro steps.

oncall-zoe: Handoff: I'll be on for another 30m then hand to @oncall-next. Current status: error rate ~1.2% and stable. Open action items: sam-deploy verify rollback completion; marta-ops verify drained hosts are healthy; infra to triage INFRA-3350; harper-eng to file RFC for cancel-behavior and include a deterministic test that simulates mid-stream client cancel.

sam-deploy: Confirmed rollout paused and rollback queued to ensure all hosts revert. Finalizing verification console output now.

[system]: infra-bot: rollback job queued for cfg-2026-03-14-1100 by sam-deploy.

leo-csm: Notified customers; acct-303 requested an ETA on permanent fix. I'll escalate to eng-runtime when RFC is available.

nina-pm: Creating incident ticket and scheduling 1hr follow-up review in 24h. Please attach logs and the config diff for cfg-2026-03-14-1100.

[system]: incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-03-14-1804567890 created by oncall-zoe.

oncall-zoe: Final note: no customer data lost; symptom was truncated streams and increased 5xx. If we see a re-increase to >5% we escalate to eng-runtime immediately. Passing to @oncall-next.

oncall-next: Taking monitoring. Ping me if anything spikes.

[thread-end]
